verdict.rationale: Docs confirm users can opt out of having conversation activity used for model training and mention Copilot 'remembers' facts users ask it to (memory), implying some retention control, but there is no explicit evidence of a deletion mechanism (e.g., clearing chat history or memory) or data-retention settings beyond the training opt-out. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/erasure controls, retention period settings, and independent confirmation that opt-out or deletion actually works as described.
